purpose: Small first read: select the current task and load only its relevant record. Full history stays in the existing archive and graph.
reload_when: A relevant repository revision or current instruction changes; compaction alone is not a reason to repeat completed reads.

jcs_verify.rule: Read latest source before assuming the old artifact is current.

xrbc_ecosystem.blocker: GitLab CI quota; require changed evidence before retry.

other_topic.rule: Select the matching routing entry, not all routes; only load the canonical contract or graph when needed.

session_contract: Current user request selects topic and output mode. Legacy next_issue is not a global todo.
Record prepared, committed, deployed and live-observed separately.
For presentation use the exact shared shell contract; for metrics map source -> request -> field -> transform -> renderer -> state.
Read back one atomic memory publication before website deployment, if memory was requested. Never add memory work after successful deployment.
